Forecast skill

How often our forecast was close to what a buoy then measured, for the buoys that stand in for each port. A forecast counts as right when it is within the stated tolerance of the reading nearest its valid time. The record covers the last 7 days and, beside it, the last 30 days; each figure shows how many forecasts it rests on. Forecasts from every model we collect are counted together. Until a window has enough history (30 distinct forecast hours across at least 7 days and 3 model runs) it reads “not enough data yet” and shows no percentage.
